name: Triangular pulse follow-up to paper-2026-09-30
failure_rule: Unchanged: first penetrating non-foot ground contact, inverted torso, nonfinite state, MuJoCo warning or controller error, checked every 4 ms. Retain every trial.
push_success_rule: Unchanged: complete and finite, no failure, prepush RMSE from 2 to 5 s <= 0.15 m/s, tracking recovery <= 0.15 m/s continuously for 0.5 s.
statistics: Three initial-condition trials per cell. One trained PPO seed. MJPC sampling unseeded. No maximum robust force claim.
execution: Two isolated CPU processes; four planning threads per MJPC trial. Synchronous offline actions. Parallel decision timing is resource-contended, not comparable with serial latency.
scope: Only pulse shape changed from original push protocol. Same peak and duration produce half rectangular impulse: 5/10/15 N s. Existing nominal dataset retained, not rerun. Not a full original-paper reproduction; 12 s rather than its declared 50 s trials.
